verdict.rationale: Brex is a SaaS platform, so an official MCP server is a fair axis, and it ships one. The first-party docs describe a Brex MCP server that lets AI assistants manage expenses, look up users, check cards, review banking transactions and track bills. They also give a concrete connection command (`claude mcp add --transport http brex https://api.brex.com/mcp`), and a probe confirms the documentation page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working, and documentation depth on auth and scopes for MCP connections.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Brex MCP server lets AI assistants interact directly with your Brex account: manage expenses, look up users, check cards, review banking transactions, track bills, and more through natural language.
claude mcp add --transport http brex https://api.brex.com/mcp
official MCP server documented at https://developer.brex.com/docs/mcp
